name: Hukaung Valley Tiger Reserve
story: Hukaung Valley Tiger Reserve is a protected area in northern Myanmar, covering 17,373.57 square kilometers in the Hukawng Valley. Established in 2004 and extended in 2010, it harbours evergreen and mixed deciduous forests.
matters: The valley is known as a habitat of tigers and the extremely rare leaf muntjac, also called the phet-gyi, dwarf deer or leaf deer.
